entries.06dd8ab56845dfc2: A holding company of a specialized trading group that sells medical devices, mainly for the circulatory system, to medical institutions, with the Tokyo metropolitan area and the Tohoku region as its main bases.
entries.1a93f3501cee1224: These are products used to treat ischemic heart disease, such as myocardial infarction and angina pectoris, including drug-eluting stents, PTCA balloon catheters and intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) diagnostic catheters, and they are the group's main product group. Treatment using these products is referred to as minimally invasive medicine, which places less strain on the body. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, its composition ratio was 22.3%, up 8.8% year on year.
